attempts.summary: Built a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-node3, AlmaLinux9, MariaDB 10.5/Galera 26.4) from scratch since no cluster pre-existed, seeded application data (appdb.orders), then added node4 as a fourth member that received the existing data via mariabackup SST and accepted writes just like the other members. Resolved two blockers along the way: wrong galera provider .so path in the initial config, and an SELinux denial blocking mariabackup SST connectto (fixed via the daemons_enable_cluster_mode boolean on all four nodes). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming boot-id changes and full 4-node quorum/data recovery after each restart.
